dialogue_template: Lights out! Lights out! You're racing. Get a clean launch and watch the car alongside.
Green lights! Make the start count. Keep it clean through Turn 1.
We're racing. Good reaction—focus on traction and leave room into the first corner.
Formation complete. Bring the tyres up to temperature and get ready for the start.
Final lap. Bring it home cleanly; manage the tyres and defend only when you need to.
Chequered flag! That's the finish. Bring the car home safely.
That's the flag. Race complete—excellent work getting to the end.
He's through! {overtaker} gets past {overtaken} and takes P{position}.
A decisive move from {overtaker}—{overtaken} is behind, and the position changes to P{position}.
Side by side, then through! {overtaker} completes the pass on {overtaken}.
That's a clean pass. {overtaker} has the inside and comes away ahead of {overtaken}.
Position gained: {overtaker} moves ahead of {overtaken}. Now the next target is up the road.
You're close enough to attack. Stay in the slipstream and choose the move carefully.
Good pressure. Look for a clean exit and make the pass stick if the gap is there.
That move didn't quite come off. Reset, protect the tyres, and look for another chance.
No way through that time. Stay patient; don't compromise the next corner trying to force it.
We have a new leader! {driver} moves into P1.
We've lost a place to {rival}. Keep your head down; there's time to respond.
The car behind is in range. Prioritise the exit and make your defence predictable.
They're looking for a way past. Cover the obvious line, but leave racing room.
Good defence. Focus on traction out of the corner; that's where you can keep the position.
Box this lap. The tyre wear is high, and the fresh set should give us a better run.
We recommend a stop now. Stay on the racing line until the pit entry, then follow the limiter.
Pit window is open. We can undercut the car ahead if the stop is clean.
You can extend this stint if the pace stays consistent. We'll reassess after the next lap.
Pit entry coming up. Hit the limiter at the line and keep it tidy.
Stop complete. Tyres are on; build temperature and get back into rhythm.
Good stop. Watch the cold tyres on the out-lap, especially under braking.
We've lost a little time in the lane. Focus on a strong out-lap and recover what we can.
The car behind may be going for the undercut. We need clean pace if we stay out.
There may be an overcut here. If your tyres are holding up, clean air could be worth staying out for.
Front tyre wear is getting high. Avoid sliding through the corners and protect the fronts.
The tyres are fading now. Smooth inputs will help us keep the pace alive.
Tyres are critical. Grip is falling away—pit if the strategy allows, and be careful under braking.
We're at the limit on this set. The car will be harder to stop and turn; avoid unnecessary risks.
Fresh rubber fitted. Build the temperature progressively; peak grip won't arrive instantly.
Tyres are still cold. Brake a little earlier and build temperature without sliding.
Tyre temperatures are climbing. Give them a cleaner corner and avoid scrubbing them.
Rain is building. Grip may fall quickly—watch the braking zones and keep an eye on the tyre call.
The rain is getting heavier around the circuit. Strategy could change quickly from here.
The racing line is drying. We'll compare lap pace before deciding whether slicks are worth the risk.
Conditions look suitable for intermediates. Confirm the grip trend before committing to the stop.
There's substantial water on track. Full wets may offer the safer option in these conditions.
Standing water reported. Reduce your risk through the puddles and avoid sharp steering inputs.
Yellow flag in {sector}. Slow down and be prepared for a hazard; no overtaking in the affected zone.
Caution, caution. There's an incident ahead in {sector}. Respect the yellow flag.
Double yellow in {sector}. Significant hazard ahead—slow down and be ready to stop.
Green flag. The track is clear and normal racing conditions have resumed.
Virtual Safety Car deployed. Follow the delta and do not overtake.
VSC is active. Keep to the required pace; we'll confirm when racing resumes.
VSC ending. Maintain the required delta until race control gives the green light.
Safety Car deployed. Reduce speed, hold position, and close up safely to the queue.
Safety Car is out. No overtaking; manage the tyres and keep a safe gap to the car ahead.
Safety Car in this lap. Stay in position and be ready for the restart.
Green flag! Racing resumes. Get a clean launch and watch for cars defending into Turn 1.
Red flag. Session suspended—slow down and follow the race-control instructions.
Red flag displayed. The race is neutralised; proceed safely and await further instructions.
Race control is reviewing the incident involving your car. We'll update you when a decision is made.
Noted: you're under investigation. Stay focused; the stewards' decision will follow when the review is complete.
No further action from the stewards. You can focus fully on the race now.
Penalty confirmed: {penalty}. We'll adjust the plan and focus on minimising the time loss.
Race control has issued a warning. Keep it clean from here and avoid giving them another reason to investigate.
Contact reported. Check the car's response and tell us if the handling feels different.
Front wing damage detected. We're likely losing downforce—consider a stop if the handling is compromised.
Brake temperatures are high. Give them some air where you can and avoid locking up.
We've got a mechanical warning. Monitor the car carefully and follow the on-screen instructions.
That's a retirement for {driver}. The car is out of the race.
We have to retire the car. Bring it to a safe location if possible and follow the instructions.
You're {gap_ahead} seconds behind {driver_ahead}. Keep the pace steady and look after the tyres.
{driver_behind} is {gap_behind} seconds behind. You're currently safe, but keep the exits clean.
That lap was strong. Keep repeating the braking points and don't overwork the tyres.
We lost time that lap. Check the exits and tyre condition; let's build it back gradually.
Fastest lap for {driver}! A new benchmark on this circuit.
Personal best. Nice lap—keep that rhythm and we'll review the next sector.
Your teammate is ahead on track. Keep the pace clean and we'll compare strategy windows.
That result could matter for the championship. Bring the car home and secure the points.
Track limits warning. Keep at least a wheel within the white line and avoid another infringement.
Race control is reviewing your launch. Keep racing; we'll report the decision when it's confirmed.
Debris reported ahead. Slow down and follow the flags until the track is confirmed clear.
Recovery complete and the track is clear. Follow the flag status for the restart.
Close the gap smoothly under the Safety Car. No sudden braking; keep a safe distance.
Watch the pit-lane speed limit. A speeding penalty would cost us more than the time gained.
Nice job keeping the position. Now focus on the next braking zone.
Clean sector. That's the sort of consistency we need over this stint.
You're getting a tow down the straight. Use it wisely and plan the braking point early.
Fuel margin is tight. Use the recommended engine mode and avoid unnecessary wheelspin.
We need a little fuel saving. Short-shift where practical and keep the exits smooth.
Victory! You take the chequered flag in P1. That's a fantastic result.
That's a podium finish in P{position}. Great work bringing it home.
